description: The IJ and Piet Hein tunnel approaches: the BGT tunnel structures (G2 input); the game keeps its inferred cuts and mouths here.

records.label: IJtunnel north approach (Kraaienplein)
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel along the Noord approach with OSM tunnel ways; the game's ramp cuts follow it. Panorama 00603: beside the approach wall. Cuts and mouths kept as inferred (game keep) until G2 places the portal from this record.

records.label: IJtunnel south approach at the Prins Hendrikkade
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel under the Prins Hendrikkade junction where the IJtunnel ramps surface; the game's ramp cuts and their mouths sit on it. Panorama 00202: the junction at street level. Kept as inferred (game keep).

records.label: IJtunnel under the Oosterdok and the Piet Heinkade
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel parts under the water and the Piet Heinkade (Bruno van Moerkerkenpassage). Panorama 00176: inside the tunnel (emergency exit signs). Kept as inferred (game keep).

records.label: Piet Heintunnel under the water by the Panamakade and the C. van Eesterenlaan
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel parts under the water between the Panamakade and the C. van Eesterenlaan, with the OSM tunnel ways. Panorama 00939: the water above it. Kept as inferred (game keep).
